content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail creators in restricted regions. Gumroad delays payouts. Stripe rejects applications. PayPal freezes funds. This stack bypasses them entirely. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, Supabase stores orders, NOWPayments verifies crypto payments. You own the code, the data, the flow. No platform can shut you down. USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction. Solana fees are fractions of a cent. Your customers pay in crypto. You convert to fiat via P2P exchanges. The infrastructure is yours. The sovereignty is permanent.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, secure these components: a Cloudflare account (free), a NOWPayments API key (free), and a Supabase project (free). Register a domain or use a GitHub Pages URL. Set up a crypto wallet to receive payments. Choose USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees. Prepare your digital products for upload. Write clear product descriptions. Test your file delivery links. Understand P2P exchange rates in your region. This stack assumes you’re ready to own your infrastructure. No platforms. No workarounds. Only sovereignty.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Deploy Cloudflare Workers to handle payment verification and product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments using your API key. Configure webhooks to fire when payments confirm on-chain. Store order data in Supabase. Use Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for file hosting. Write serverless functions to automate delivery. Test each step manually before going live. Ensure USDT payments on Tron or Solana trigger instant product access. Your pipeline must be seamless. Your customers must trust it. Your sovereignty depends on it.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction — faster and cheaper than PayPal.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your stack to Cloudflare Pages. Test the entire flow with a real transaction. Send USDT on Tron or Solana to your NOWPayments address. Verify the webhook triggers product delivery. Check Supabase for the order record. Convert the crypto to fiat via P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. Document every step. Fix any breaks. Once live, monitor transactions. Respond to customer issues directly. No platform intermediaries. No payout delays. Only your infrastructure. Only your rules.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With the stack live, scale strategically. Add more products to your catalog. Optimize file delivery for larger downloads. Monitor transaction fees on Tron and Solana. Switch networks if costs rise. Automate P2P conversions using exchange APIs. Back up your Supabase data daily. Document your processes for future reference. Train your team to manage the stack. This infrastructure is not a workaround. It’s your base layer. Scale it like one. Own it like one.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for digital products, deploy a stack using NOWPayments, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic payment verification. Use Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic and product delivery. Store order data in Supabase. Choose USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees. Deliver products instantly upon payment confirmation. Convert crypto to fiat via P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. This infrastructure gives you full sovereignty over your commerce.
Cloudflare Workers and Supabase give you full control over your commerce stack.

To deploy this stack faster, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration, deployed in 48 hours. Five products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more. Whether you build it yourself or deploy a pre-configured stack, the goal is the same: own your infrastructure, bypass platforms, and control your commerce.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Register a Cloudflare account and set up Workers. 2. Create a NOWPayments account and generate an API key. 3. Launch a Supabase project for order storage. 4. Prepare your digital products and test file delivery links. 5. Write serverless functions for payment verification and product delivery. 6. Configure NOWPayments webhooks to trigger Cloudflare Workers. 7. Deploy your stack to Cloudflare Pages. 8. Test the entire flow with a real USDT transaction on Tron or Solana. 9. Convert received crypto to fiat via P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. 10. Monitor transactions and scale your infrastructure as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I choose between USDT on Tron and Solana for payments?

Choose USDT on Tron for stable fees under $0.10 per transaction. Choose Solana for fees averaging fractions of a cent. Both networks are fast and reliable. Select based on your audience’s preference and your region’s exchange rates.
Can I convert USDT to local currency directly from NOWPayments?

NOWPayments does not convert crypto to fiat. Use P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert USDT to your local currency. These platforms offer competitive rates and fast settlements in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya.
What happens if a payment fails or the customer disputes it?

If a payment fails, NOWPayments will not trigger the webhook. Communicate directly with the customer to resolve issues. Since you own the infrastructure, you handle disputes without platform interference. Document all transactions for reference.
How do I secure my Cloudflare Workers and Supabase data?

Use Cloudflare’s built-in security features like WAF and rate limiting. Encrypt sensitive data in Supabase. Restrict API keys to specific IP addresses. Regularly audit your stack for vulnerabilities. Security is your responsibility when you own the infrastructure.
Can I use this stack to sell physical products, not just digital ones?

This stack is designed for digital products with instant delivery. For physical products, you’ll need to integrate shipping logic and order tracking. Consider using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) as a starting point and customize it for physical goods.
